tech_news.title: LG smart TVs caught logging audio with screen off and snooping on local devices - notebookcheck.net
tech_news.description: An investigation by Gamers Nexus found LG smart TVs sweep local networks to map phones and nearby devices. Tests also showed the sets can capture microphone audio with the screen off — they then upload data once reconnected to the internet.
